create_cached_path: create a cached path from a URL or local file path, downloading and caching if needed
build_filename_to_url: build a reverse lookup from cached filename back to its original URL and ETag metadata
test_url_to_filename: test converting a URL into a repeatable SHA-256 hashed filename with optional ETag suffix
run_read_set_from_file: run reading a text file and extracting a de-duplicated set of lines
summarize_get_from_cache: summarize downloading a URL to a local cache directory with ETag-based versioning and S3 support
